core: Urea cycle and glutamate/aspartate-family amino acid metabolism
qualifier: with malate-aspartate shuttle and ammonium handling
name: Urea cycle and glutamate/aspartate-family amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members cover urea cycle enzymes and their inherited defects, ornithine/arginine/citrulline/proline/glutamine/aspartate metabolism and ammonium homeostasis; unlike the broader amino acid neighbour it includes the malate-aspartate shuttle and lacks sulfur, aromatic and glycine/serine catabolism, and unlike the others it is centred on the urea cycle.

qualifier: including adenohypophysis
name: Forebrain dorsoventral patterning, morphogenesis and adenohypophysis development
rationale: All three members concern early forebrain/ventral diencephalic patterning and morphogenesis including the anterior pituitary, distinct from cortical migration, spinal cord patterning, neural plate and neuroblast division neighbours.

qualifier: and its negative regulation
name: Type II interferon (IFN-gamma) signaling and its regulation
rationale: All members are IFN-gamma receptor signaling or its regulation, whereas confusables are IL-10/IL-27/IL-12 family cytokine signaling or Th1 differentiation that produces IFN-gamma.

qualifier: iron/heme, copper and manganese
name: Iron, heme, copper and manganese transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members are transport and homeostasis of transition metals (transferrin/heme/ferroportin iron handling, copper, manganese, cobalt); the cadmium-detox neighbours lack heme/iron handling and the iron-import neighbours lack copper and manganese.

core: Regulation of protein stability and proteasomal degradation
qualifier: cullin neddylation and COP9 signalosome
name: Cullin neddylation, COP9 signalosome and protein stability control
rationale: Members concern neddylation/deneddylation of cullin-RING ligases, their CUL3 adaptors (RHOBTB) and substrates, and regulation of protein stabilization/destabilization; neighbours instead concern chaperonin folding, PD-L1 degradation or deubiquitinases.

qualifier: with alkylation damage reversal and active DNA demethylation
name: Base excision repair, alkylation reversal and active DNA demethylation
rationale: Members are glycosylase-initiated base excision repair steps plus direct reversal of alkylation (MGMT, ALKBH2/3) and TET/TDG demethylation, which the glycosylase-defect neighbours lack.

qualifier: cardiac and vascular smooth muscle, phenotypic switching
name: Cardiac and vascular smooth muscle cell growth and differentiation
rationale: Members regulate proliferation, differentiation, hypertrophy and phenotypic switching of cardiomyocytes and vascular smooth muscle cells; one neighbour covers heart chamber morphogenesis without smooth muscle and others vascular remodeling without cardiac muscle.

qualifier: nasal-olfactory, trigeminal/facial nerve, lacrimal and salivary
name: Nasal-olfactory, cranial nerve and lacrimal/salivary gland development
rationale: Members concern development and function of nose/olfactory structures, cranial (trigeminal, facial) nerves and ganglia, taste papillae and lacrimal/salivary glands, whereas neighbours concern inner/outer ear and hindbrain.

core: Innate receptor signaling to NF-kappaB and stress kinases
qualifier: TLR, NOD and TNFR family
name: TLR, NOD and TNFR signaling to NF-kappaB and JNK/p38
rationale: Members are IKK/NF-kappaB (canonical and non-canonical) and JNK/p38 activation downstream of TLR, NOD1/2, TNFR-family and related receptors and its ubiquitin-dependent regulation; neighbours concern endosomal TLR trafficking, cytokine production control or T cell activation.

qualifier: excitatory, neurexin-neuroligin and PSD-95/NMDA receptor clustering
name: Excitatory postsynapse assembly via neurexin-neuroligin and PSD-95
rationale: All members concern neurexin-neuroligin-driven postsynaptic membrane assembly with PSD-95 and NMDA receptor clustering, unlike the inhibitory (gephyrin/GABA receptor) and presynaptic/adhesion neighbours.

qualifier: stem cell maintenance and erythroid-megakaryocyte lineage, RUNX1
name: Hematopoietic stem cell and erythroid-megakaryocyte lineage differentiation
rationale: Members cover HSC/progenitor maintenance, RUNX1-driven hematopoietic transcription and erythrocyte, megakaryocyte and early myeloid differentiation; neighbours focus on monocyte/granulocyte differentiation or non-hematopoietic RUNX1 targets.

qualifier: neutrophil killing, metal sequestration and microbial cytolysis
name: Antimicrobial effector defense via neutrophil killing and metal sequestration
rationale: Members are effector antibacterial/antifungal defense in mucosa: neutrophil killing, metal sequestration, bacterial agglutination and cytolysis; neighbours center on defensins and antimicrobial peptide production.

qualifier: cyclooxygenase route plus prostanoid/leukotriene receptors
name: Cyclooxygenase prostaglandin synthesis and prostanoid/leukotriene receptor signaling
rationale: Members cover PLA2/COX prostaglandin and thromboxane synthesis, its regulation and prostanoid and leukotriene GPCRs; neighbours instead cover lipoxygenase leukotriene synthesis or cytochrome P450 eicosanoids.

core: Renal regulation of blood pressure and volume
qualifier: angiotensin and guanylyl cyclase/cGMP signaling, natriuresis
name: Renal natriuresis and blood volume via angiotensin and cGMP
rationale: Members concern renal sodium excretion, urine volume and blood pressure via renin-angiotensin and receptor guanylyl cyclase/cGMP signaling, which neighbours on angiotensinogen processing, vasoconstriction or glomerular filtration lack.

qualifier: COPII and COPI coats
name: COPII and COPI vesicle-mediated ER-Golgi trafficking
rationale: Members are COPII export, COPI anterograde/retrograde and intra-Golgi vesicle budding, tethering and targeting, distinct from Golgi organization, ER quality control and COPI-independent retrograde neighbours.

core: Fatty acid oxidation and cholesterol catabolism
qualifier: alpha/beta/omega-oxidation and oxysterol bile acid synthesis
name: Fatty acid alpha/beta/omega-oxidation and oxysterol bile acid synthesis
rationale: Members are peroxisomal/ER oxidation of very-long, branched and medium-chain fatty acids and bile acid synthesis from 24/27-hydroxycholesterol with their inherited defects, which the peroxisome-biogenesis and lipid-synthesis neighbours lack.

core: Sulfur, selenium and methylamine compound catabolism
qualifier: transsulfuration plus choline/carnitine/trimethylamine
name: Transsulfuration, selenium methylation and choline/trimethylamine catabolism
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration and cysteine/serine catabolism, selenocompound metabolism and excretion, and choline, carnitine and FMO trimethylamine oxidation; neighbours lack the choline/FMO arm or the sulfur/selenium arm.

qualifier: cohesion, condensation, spindle, nuclear envelope and cytokinesis
name: Mitotic chromosome cohesion, spindle, nuclear envelope and cytokinesis
rationale: Members span the structural events of mitosis from cohesion and condensation through spindle/centrosome assembly, nuclear envelope breakdown/reformation and cytokinesis; neighbours are chromatin assembly, meiosis or APC/C-driven mitotic exit.

qualifier: axonemal dynein and left-right asymmetry
name: Motile cilium axoneme assembly and left-right asymmetry
rationale: Members concern axonemal dynein/central apparatus assembly in motile cilia and sperm and the nodal-cilia-driven left-right asymmetry of organs, which the multiciliogenesis and CSF-flow neighbours lack.

qualifier: astral microtubule-cortex anchoring
name: Spindle orientation via astral microtubules and cortical anchoring
rationale: Members concern spindle localization/orientation through astral microtubule stabilization and cortical/actin protein localization, unlike neighbours on centrosome positioning, microtubule nucleation or tubulin modification.

core: Transcriptional control of lipid and glucose metabolism
qualifier: nutrient-sensing (LXR, SREBP, ChREBP, PPARA, PGC-1alpha)
name: Nutrient-sensing transcriptional control of lipogenesis and gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members are sugar-, fatty acid- and sterol-responsive transcriptional regulators of triglyceride, cholesterol and glucose metabolism; neighbours instead focus on adipocyte differentiation, glucagon/PKA signaling or SREBP processing.

qualifier: choline uptake, acetylcholine release and nicotinic receptors
name: Cholinergic transmission via choline uptake and nicotinic receptors
rationale: Members cover presynaptic choline transport (SLC5A7), acetylcholine synthesis and release and nicotinic receptor-mediated neuromuscular transmission, which muscarinic, botulinum toxin, GABA transport and NMJ assembly neighbours lack.

qualifier: break sensing, NHEJ and HR/NHEJ pathway choice
name: Double-strand break sensing, end joining and repair pathway choice
rationale: Members are DSB sensing/ATM signaling, classical and alternative NHEJ and regulation of NHEJ versus HR, whereas neighbours concern end resection, HR strand exchange and BRCA defects.

qualifier: astral microtubules
name: Astral microtubule-driven mitotic spindle positioning and orientation
rationale: All four members concern astral microtubule organization and spindle assembly, localization and orientation, unlike centrosome maturation, centrosome positioning or neuroblast division neighbours.

qualifier: Fc-gamma receptor and DAP12-driven Rac/Arp2/3 actin remodeling
name: Fc-gamma receptor and DAP12-driven phagocytic actin remodeling
rationale: Members are FCGR/DAP12 tyrosine kinase signaling driving Rac-WASP/WAVE-Arp2/3 actin polymerization for phagocytic cup and lamellipodium formation; neighbours concern BCR signaling, inhibitory Fc receptors or ADCC without the actin machinery.
